hooks.name: Regenerate fixtures on profile or generator change
hooks.description: When a card profile in public/profiles/ or scripts/make_fixtures.ts is saved, regenerate tests/fixtures/ and fail loudly if any PNG changed. Shell command only, no agent prompt. run-logged.sh passes the exit status through and writes one evidence line, also when the run is cut short; its 50 s deadline sits below the 60 s timeout here and far above the slowest measured run (0.77 s, docs/BUILD_LOG.md).

action.command: sh .kiro/hooks/bin/run-logged.sh "Regenerate fixtures on profile or generator change" 50 sh .kiro/hooks/bin/check-fixtures.sh
